name: Forgejo
hook: Self-hosted Git forge — lightweight, community-governed, privacy-first.
bullets: Runs on a Raspberry Pi — ~170MB RAM vs GitLab's 8GB
GitHub Actions-compatible CI via Forgejo Actions
Community-governed by non-profit Codeberg e.V., GPL-3.0 licensed
setupSteps: Download the Forgejo binary for your platform
Run the binary or use Docker: docker run -p 3000:3000 codeberg/forgejo
Open the web UI and complete the first-run setup
Create repos, invite collaborators, set up CI runners
details: Forgejo is a community-governed, self-hosted Git forge — a lightweight alternative to GitHub and GitLab. Written in Go, it provides repositories, issues, pull requests with code review, wikis, a package and container registry, LFS, and Forgejo Actions (CI/CD compatible with GitHub Actions YAML). It idles at ~170MB RAM, runs on anything from a Raspberry Pi to a dedicated server, and is governed by the non-profit Codeberg e.V. — not a corporation. Federation via ActivityPub is actively developed. Licensed under GPL-3.0.
